boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Transylvania University
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe Lexington food stops with late service or 24-hour availability.

cards.title: Halal Munchies Lexington
cards.subtitle: 395 S Limestone, Lexington
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page to confirm the day before heading out; it lists food service until 2 AM most nights and 4 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A S Limestone halal-food stop with explicitly posted late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Halal Munchies lists hours until 2 AM Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 4 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant hours: 10:30 AM–2 AM Monday–Thursday and Sunday; 10:30 AM–4 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Sushi Blue
cards.subtitle: 185 Pasadena Drive, Suite 130, Lexington
cards.notes: Check the venue’s daily listing before making the trip; its official page states sushi is served from 6 PM until 2 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: A Pasadena Drive restaurant whose official page documents daily 2 AM service.
cards.evidence_claim: Sushi Blue states that it serves sushi from 6 PM to 2 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists service 6 PM–2 AM every day.

cards.title: IHOP on Norman Lane
cards.subtitle: 2380 Norman Lane, Lexington
cards.notes: This IHOP’s location page lists 24-hour Friday and Saturday operation; use the posted day-by-day schedule when planning a late meal.
cards.short_summary: A Norman Lane IHOP with official weekend 24-hour hours.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists this Lexington location as open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official schedule: open 24 hours Friday and Saturday; other listed days close at 10 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Harrodsburg Road
cards.subtitle: 1970 Harrodsburg Road, Lexington
cards.notes: For a late pickup, confirm whether you need the drive-thru: the location lists it through 3 AM daily, while dine-in closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Harrodsburg Road Taco Bell with daily 3 AM drive-thru hours posted.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 AM–3 AM every day at 1970 Harrodsburg Road.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed daily until 3 AM; listed dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Versailles Road
cards.subtitle: 2323 Versailles Road, Lexington
cards.notes: Plan on using the drive-thru late: the official location page posts 3 AM Friday–Saturday closing and 2 AM Sunday–Thursday closing.
cards.short_summary: A Versailles Road Taco Bell with late drive-thru availability documented by day.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 3 AM Friday–Saturday and 2 AM Sunday–Thursday at 2323 Versailles Road.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 3 AM Friday–Saturday; until 2 AM Sunday–Thursday. Listed dine-in closes earlier.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 320 New Circle Road NW
cards.title: Taco Bell on New Circle Road NW
cards.subtitle: 320 New Circle Road NW, Lexington
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a very late order; the location’s current official page lists daily service through 4 AM and earlier dine-in closing.
cards.short_summary: A New Circle Road NW Taco Bell with daily 4 AM drive-thru hours posted.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 AM–4 AM every day at 320 New Circle Road NW.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell—320 New Circle Road NW
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed daily until 4 AM; listed dine-in hours end at midnight.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Nicholasville Road
cards.subtitle: 2275 Nicholasville Road, Lexington
cards.notes: This location’s official page posts drive-thru service through 4 AM every day; verify the current service mode before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Nicholasville Road Taco Bell with officially listed daily 4 AM drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9 AM–4 AM every day at 2275 Nicholasville Road.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru service until 4 AM daily.

cards.title: Waffle House on South Broadway
cards.subtitle: 859 South Broadway, Lexington
cards.notes: The chain’s Lexington location directory identifies this South Broadway restaurant as Waffle House #1565 and currently marks it open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A South Broadway Waffle House listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official Lexington directory lists Waffle House #1565 at 859 South Broadway as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Waffle House Locations in Lexington, KY
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently labels this location “Open 24 hours.”

cards.title: Waffle House on Georgetown Road
cards.subtitle: 1012 Georgetown Road, Lexington
cards.notes: The official Lexington directory names this Georgetown Road location Waffle House #1099 and currently shows it as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A Georgetown Road Waffle House with 24-hour availability listed by the chain.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official Lexington directory lists Waffle House #1099 at 1012 Georgetown Road as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Waffle House Locations in Lexington, KY
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently labels this location “Open 24 hours.”

cards.title: Waffle House on Winchester Road
cards.subtitle: 1134 Winchester Road, Lexington
cards.notes: The chain’s official Lexington directory identifies this as Waffle House #2299 and currently marks it open 24 hours for a late meal.
cards.short_summary: A Winchester Road Waffle House listed by its operator as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House’s official Lexington directory lists Waffle House #2299 at 1134 Winchester Road as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Waffle House Locations in Lexington, KY
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently labels this location “Open 24 hours.”

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus spaces for studying, meeting, recreation, dining, reflection and hands-on community work.

cards.title: William T. Young Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Campus-life hub
cards.notes: Start here to find student services, club meeting areas, dining, fitness and event space in one building; check the campus center for current availability.
cards.short_summary: A central building that combines student-life services with places to meet, eat and work out.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania describes the William T. Young Campus Center as the hub for student organizations, student services, dining, fitness and events.
cards.access_notes: Campus facilities and event spaces may have reservations or access rules; verify with Campus Center staff before planning a group use.

cards.title: The Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Young Campus Center dining room
cards.notes: Use a meal-plan meal or visitor purchase, then stay at a table for a study session, group meeting or low-key game between commitments.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining room also designated for studying, meetings and hanging out.
cards.evidence_claim: The university calls the Great Hall its main dining facility and says it is always open for study space, group meetings, hanging out and games.
cards.access_notes: Dining use involves a meal plan or purchase; confirm service and seating conditions with Dining Services.

cards.title: Rafskeller
cards.subtitle: Young Campus Center grab-and-go dining
cards.notes: Pick up a meal or coffee and use it as a casual meetup point in the campus center; consult Dining Services for the current menu and hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus-center food stop identified by the university as its grab-and-go and late-night dining option.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania identifies the Rafskeller, or “The Raf,” as a grab-and-go and late-night dining option in the Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages require payment or meal-plan funds; review Dining Services' current menu and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Hearth Room
cards.subtitle: Young Campus Center lounge
cards.notes: Bring reading or a laptop and settle into the fireplace lounge for quiet, comfortable work; leave room for others during busy campus-center periods.
cards.short_summary: A furnished campus-center lounge explicitly intended for studying and lounging.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania describes the Hearth Room as a cozy space with a fireplace and comfortable furniture for studying and lounging.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Campus Center; confirm any event-related restrictions with Campus Center staff.

cards.title: Valvoline Game Room
cards.subtitle: Young Campus Center recreation space
cards.notes: Meet friends for a recreational break, then check equipment out from the attendant using a valid Crimson ID and follow the posted room policies.
cards.short_summary: A designated social and recreation room for the Transy community.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the Valvoline Game Room is a space for the Transy community to socialize, network and take part in recreational activities.
cards.access_notes: Permitted users are Transylvania students, alumni, staff, faculty and their guests; equipment checkout requires a valid Transy Crimson ID.

cards.title: J. Douglas Gay Jr. Library
cards.subtitle: Library and academic-support building
cards.notes: Choose a library study spot, then head to the lower-floor Academic Center for Excellence when you need writing, tutoring or research support.
cards.short_summary: A study destination that also houses academic-assistance services and librarian research help.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania states that the Academic Center for Excellence is on the library’s lower floor and that librarians help students find quality resources and refine research topics.
cards.access_notes: The university lists library space among study areas available to students; ask library or ACE staff about service availability.

cards.title: Alumni Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor gathering area
cards.notes: Pause at the engraved bricks and pavers, use the seating for a quick outdoor conversation, and treat the landscaping and memorial elements with care.
cards.short_summary: A former pass-through remade as a seated gathering area with engraved donor pavers.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania says Alumni Plaza was transformed from a concrete pass-through into a gathering area with seating, foliage and engraved bricks and pavers.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space may be reserved for events; follow university outdoor-space policies and any posted restrictions.

cards.title: Transylvania Community Garden
cards.subtitle: Behind Poole Residence Hall
cards.notes: Visit the garden behind Poole to see student-maintained growing space, and contact Campus and Community Engagement before joining maintenance or volunteer work.
cards.short_summary: A student-maintained campus garden used in teaching and community-focused activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania says its community garden is behind Poole Residence Hall, is maintained by students and has been used for a May Term class.
cards.access_notes: Treat the garden as an active maintained space; ask the university before harvesting, volunteering or organizing an activity there.

cards.title: Old Morrison Chapel
cards.subtitle: Stained-glass campus chapel
cards.notes: Look for the student-created artwork and attend an announced Spirituality and Religious Life program; use the chapel respectfully and check event details first.
cards.short_summary: A stained-glass chapel that hosts Spirituality and Religious Life programming and displays student art.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Old Morrison Chapel hosts Spirituality and Religious Life events, including Wake Up Wednesday and regular Catholic Mass, and features student-created art.
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; the university directs non-wedding inquiries to its listed chapel contact.

cards.title: Sanders-Siebers Entrepreneurship Hub
cards.subtitle: Rosenthal Commons Room
cards.notes: Use this named Rosenthal Commons social spot as a place to connect between classes, and check with Residence Life before planning a meeting or program.
cards.short_summary: A named social space housed in Rosenthal Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania identifies the Sanders-Siebers Entrepreneurship Hub in Rosenthal Commons as one of the campus spaces students can make their own social spot.
cards.access_notes: Located in a residential complex; confirm visitor and room-use expectations with Housing and Residence Life.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission ways to spend time together on campus and around Lexington.

cards.title: Visit Morlan Gallery
cards.subtitle: Mitchell Fine Arts Center, Transylvania University
cards.notes: Check the exhibition listing, then walk through the gallery together and spend a few minutes comparing one work that catches each person’s attention.
cards.short_summary: A campus contemporary-art stop with free public programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania’s Morlan Gallery says its artist lectures, exhibition receptions, and events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free public programming; confirm the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Browse Central Library
cards.subtitle: 140 East Main Street, downtown Lexington
cards.notes: Meet by the Foucault pendulum, browse the Kentucky Room or gallery, and use the library as an indoor conversation-and-reading stop.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library with public spaces, exhibits, and local-history resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington Public Library describes itself as providing free and open access to information and lists Central Library’s public facilities.
cards.access_notes: Public library location; borrowing materials may require a library card.

cards.title: See the UK Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Singletary Center for the Arts, University of Kentucky
cards.notes: Choose one gallery at a time, then trade observations about a work without rushing through the full museum or buying anything.
cards.short_summary: Free university-museum admission for a focused art break.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Kentucky Parents & Families states that admission to the University of Kentucky Art Museum is always free.
cards.source_title: Spring Family Reunion Events | University of Kentucky
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; check museum hours and exhibition availability before going.

cards.title: Walk the 21c galleries
cards.subtitle: 167 West Main Street, downtown Lexington
cards.notes: Enter for the contemporary installations, take a slow gallery loop, and use the artwork as a prompt for a relaxed group discussion.
cards.short_summary: Contemporary art galleries open to the public every day.
cards.evidence_claim: 21c’s Lexington exhibition brochure says its contemporary art museum is free and open to the public every day of the year.
cards.access_notes: Museum galleries are free and public; restaurant purchases are optional and not part of this activity.

cards.title: Look into Artists' Attic
cards.subtitle: The Square, 401 West Main Street
cards.notes: Visit during listed daytime hours, view the featured exhibition, and respectfully look into working studios when artists are present.
cards.short_summary: A downtown gallery and working-studio visit with free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Square states that Artists’ Attic is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free public entry; the source lists Monday–Saturday daytime hours.

cards.entity_name: The Arboretum, State Botanical Garden of Kentucky
cards.title: Walk Across Kentucky
cards.subtitle: 500 Alumni Drive, University of Kentucky
cards.notes: Follow part of the Walk Across Kentucky trail, pausing at signs and plantings; bring water and stay on marked paths from dawn to dusk.
cards.short_summary: A 100-acre public garden with a free, self-guided native-plant walk.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Kentucky states that The Arboretum is open 365 days a year from dawn to dusk and that admission is free.
cards.source_title: Plant Study Sites | University of Kentucky
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; the grounds close to the public on UK football home-game days.

cards.title: See an Institute 193 exhibition
cards.subtitle: 215 North Limestone Street, downtown Lexington
cards.notes: Check the exhibition page before heading over, then give yourselves time to engage with the work without treating the gallery shop as required.
cards.short_summary: A North Limestone exhibition space listed as free for self-guided visits.
cards.evidence_claim: VisitLEX lists Institute 193 as free and identifies self-guided tours at its North Limestone gallery.
cards.access_notes: Listed as free; verify current exhibition hours directly with Institute 193.

cards.title: Take a LexArts HOP gallery stroll
cards.subtitle: Participating Lexington galleries; includes Morlan Gallery
cards.notes: Use the official guide to select a few participating venues, walk the route with friends, and focus on the exhibitions rather than purchases.
cards.short_summary: A recurring citywide gallery evening with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: LexArts HOP states that it takes place every other month and that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Free admission; confirm participating venues and current dates on the official HOP guide.

cards.title: Walk McConnell Springs trails
cards.subtitle: 416 Rebmann Lane, Lexington
cards.notes: Follow the nearly two miles of trails with a friend, stopping at the spring features and historic markers while keeping to designated routes.
cards.short_summary: A city natural-area park with trails and karst springs.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington Parks & Recreation describes McConnell Springs as a natural-area park with nearly two miles of trails for all to enjoy.
cards.source_title: McConnell Springs Park | City of Lexington
cards.access_notes: City park access requires no admission or purchase; follow posted park guidelines.

cards.title: Take a respectful cemetery walk
cards.subtitle: 833 West Main Street, Lexington
cards.notes: Use the cemetery roads for a quiet walk, read historic markers from a distance, and observe visitor rules around graves, services, and lakes.
cards.short_summary: A historic public cemetery whose visitor rules permit walking.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lexington Cemetery identifies itself as a public cemetery, invites the public to enjoy its garden-and-park setting, and limits sports activity to walking.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open daily; no admission or purchase is required. Visitors under 18 must be accompanied by a responsible adult.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Transylvania locations with documented study, research, writing, or collaborative-work affordances.

cards.entity_name: J. Douglas Gay Jr./Frances Carrick Thomas Library
cards.title: J. Douglas Gay Jr./Frances Carrick Thomas Library
cards.subtitle: 300 N. Broadway, Transylvania University
cards.notes: Start here for a research-focused session: use the collection, then ask a reference librarian to help refine a topic or locate scholarly sources.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines collections, research guidance, and dedicated academic-support space.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania describes this library as the scholarly heart of campus and says reference librarians provide research guidance.
cards.access_notes: Visitors are welcome in the library; check the library-hours link before visiting.

cards.title: Farris Rare Book Room
cards.subtitle: J. Douglas Gay Jr./Frances Carrick Thomas Library
cards.notes: Plan a source-driven visit around the rare-book collection; contact library staff in advance to confirm how to consult special-collections materials.
cards.short_summary: A named special-collections room for working closely with distinctive historical materials.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies the Farris Rare Book Room as part of its special collections, alongside medical texts and university archives.
cards.access_notes: Special-collections access procedures are not stated on the overview page; contact the library before planning a visit.

cards.title: Academic Center for Excellence
cards.subtitle: Lower level of the library
cards.notes: Bring a collaborative assignment or draft to the lower-level ACE, where movable furniture, whiteboards, booths, tables, and shared monitors support group work.
cards.short_summary: A flexible academic-support environment built for tutoring, writing, and collaborative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: ACE is in the library’s lower level and provides movable furniture, whiteboards, booths, tables, and monitors for collaborative work.
cards.access_notes: Academic support is housed in the lower level of the library; consult ACE or library information for current availability.

cards.title: Transylvania University Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Academic Center for Excellence, lower level of the library
cards.notes: Use this setting when a paper needs conversation and revision: schedule or seek a writing consultation through ACE’s current support options.
cards.short_summary: A campus writing-development space located with the university’s academic support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania says its Writing Center is a space for the campus community to discuss and develop writing.
cards.source_title: Academic Center for Excellence | Transylvania University
cards.access_notes: Located in the library’s lower level as part of ACE; confirm consultation availability directly with ACE.

cards.title: ACE Collaboration/Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Academic Center for Excellence, lower level of the library
cards.notes: Choose one of the smaller ACE rooms for a one-on-one tutoring session or small-group meeting, and confirm availability with the center first.
cards.short_summary: Smaller rooms inside ACE intended for tutoring appointments and compact group sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania reports that ACE has smaller study rooms for one-on-one tutoring appointments or small-group meetings.
cards.source_title: Transylvania offers resources to support holistic student success
cards.access_notes: The rooms support tutoring and small-group meetings; availability or reservation rules are not stated on the source page.

cards.title: William T. Young Campus Center
cards.subtitle: 300 North Broadway, Transylvania University
cards.notes: Set up in the campus center when you want study time near dining and student services; select a common area that is not reserved for an event.
cards.short_summary: The student-life hub contains study-friendly common areas, dining, events, and services.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania says the campus center has bright areas for student organizations, services, dining, fitness, and events.
cards.source_title: William T. Young Campus Center | Transylvania University
cards.access_notes: Event and meeting spaces may be in use; use common areas consistent with campus-center operations.

cards.title: Great Hall
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring reading or a group agenda between meals: the Great Hall is explicitly available for study space and group meetings, as well as dining.
cards.short_summary: A campus-center dining hall that the university also designates for studying and group meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania states that the Great Hall is always open for study space, group meetings, hanging out, or games.
cards.source_title: William T. Young Campus Center | Transylvania University
cards.access_notes: The university says the Great Hall is always open for study space and group meetings.

cards.title: Hearth Room
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Choose the Hearth Room for reading or laptop work in a furnished common room; keep your setup compact so the shared lounge remains welcoming.
cards.short_summary: A campus-center living-room setting with a fireplace and comfortable furniture for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania describes the Hearth Room as a cozy space with a fireplace and comfortable furniture for studying and lounging.
cards.source_title: William T. Young Campus Center | Transylvania University
cards.access_notes: This is a shared campus-center lounge; availability can vary with normal building use.

cards.title: Rafskeller
cards.subtitle: William T. Young Campus Center dining facility
cards.notes: Use a table for a short independent work block around campus-center activities; treat it as shared dining space and follow posted dining operations.
cards.short_summary: A named campus dining venue that falls within the university’s listed study-area options.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania lists campus dining facilities among study areas available to students and identifies the Rafskeller as a campus dining option.
cards.access_notes: The Rafskeller is a campus dining facility; check current dining operations before relying on a table.

cards.title: Gratz Perk
cards.subtitle: Transylvania University campus dining facility
cards.notes: Pair a focused laptop task with a stop at this named campus dining location, while keeping in mind that seating is part of an active shared facility.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus dining location within the university’s documented study-area network.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania lists campus dining facilities as student study areas and names Gratz Perk as a location where Crimson Card funds may be used.
cards.access_notes: Gratz Perk is identified as a campus dining option; check current dining operations before visiting.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, visually documentable destinations on corridors in Transylvania University’s nearby Lexington orbit.

cards.title: North Broadway — Lexington History Museum
cards.subtitle: North Broadway corridor; 210–214 N. Broadway
cards.notes: Enter through the auditorium portion of the building and use the museum’s current public hours when planning a focused local-history visit.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum with public exhibits and group-tour options.
cards.evidence_claim: LexHistory lists its location at 210–214 North Broadway and describes its mission as interpreting Lexington and Bluegrass-region history.
cards.access_notes: Listed public hours: Thursday–Friday noon–4 p.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. Verify before visiting.

cards.title: Loudon Avenue — Greyline Station
cards.subtitle: West Loudon Avenue corridor; 101 W. Loudon Ave.
cards.notes: Use the merchant directory before you go to identify a particular food or retail stop inside the repurposed transit-station building.
cards.short_summary: A public marketplace with food and retail merchants in a historic transit building.
cards.evidence_claim: Greyline Station identifies itself as a public marketplace with food and retail merchants at 101 West Loudon Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Merchant offerings and individual hours vary; consult the marketplace directory before visiting.

cards.title: East Third Street — Lyric Theatre
cards.subtitle: East Third Street corridor; 300 E. Third St.
cards.notes: Check the museum and gallery hours or the event calendar, then plan time to see the cultural center’s public spaces.
cards.short_summary: A cultural-arts venue with museum and gallery access during posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lyric Theatre & Cultural Arts Center lists museum and gallery hours and its address at 300 East Third Street.
cards.source_title: Lyric Theatre & Cultural Arts Center Contact
cards.access_notes: Museum and gallery hours are listed Tuesday–Friday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm programming before arrival.

cards.title: Castlewood Drive — Loudoun House
cards.subtitle: Castlewood Drive corridor; 209 Castlewood Dr.
cards.notes: Pair a walk through Castlewood Park with a close look at the Gothic Revival house and its Lexington Art League setting.
cards.short_summary: A documented Gothic Revival house set within Castlewood Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library of Congress identifies Loudoun House as a Gothic Revival mansion in Lexington’s Castlewood Park and dates its photographed site to 2020.
cards.source_title: Library of Congress: Loudoun House mansion in Lexington's Castlewood Park
cards.access_notes: The historic house is in Castlewood Park; check Lexington Art League programming for any interior-access details.

cards.title: Castlewood Drive — Castlewood Park
cards.subtitle: Castlewood Drive corridor; 201 Castlewood Dr.
cards.notes: Use this city-listed park as an outdoor stop, and keep the Loudoun House in view as a nearby landmark for photographs.
cards.short_summary: A city park on Castlewood Drive with the Loudoun House nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington’s parks directory lists Castlewood Park at 201 Castlewood Drive.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; observe posted park rules and any temporary closures.

cards.title: North Limestone Street — Duncan Park
cards.subtitle: North Limestone Street corridor; 530 N. Limestone St.
cards.notes: Bring a book or sketchpad for a brief outdoor pause, using the city’s park listing to confirm this North Limestone location.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed outdoor destination on North Limestone Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington’s parks directory lists Duncan Park at 530 North Limestone Street.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; observe posted park rules and any temporary closures.

cards.title: East Third Street — Isaac Murphy Memorial Art Garden
cards.subtitle: East Third Street corridor; 577 E. Third St.
cards.notes: Use the garden’s city-listed address to add an outdoor art-focused stop to an East Third Street walk toward the Lyric.
cards.short_summary: A named city park and art-garden destination on East Third Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington’s parks directory lists Isaac Murphy Memorial Art Garden at 577 East Third Street.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor city-park access; observe posted park rules and any temporary closures.

cards.title: East Main Street — Phoenix Park
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor; 100 E. Main St.
cards.notes: Visit the reimagined park during the day and check the city calendar if you want to pair the playground and stage with public programming.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public park with a playground, performance stage, and programmed events.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington states that Phoenix Park at Main and Limestone was reopened with a playground, performance stage, and other public features.
cards.source_title: City cuts ribbon to reopen reimagined Phoenix Park
cards.access_notes: The city lists Phoenix Park at 100 E. Main St.; consult its calendar for specific public events.

cards.title: East Main Street — Pam Miller Downtown Arts Center
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor; 141 E. Main St.
cards.notes: Check current gallery displays or a Black Box Theatre event, then use the posted facility hours for a daytime arts stop.
cards.short_summary: A city-run arts center with galleries, theatre, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The city identifies Pam Miller Downtown Arts Center at 141 East Main Street and lists its theatre and gallery facilities.
cards.access_notes: Posted facility hours vary by day and may change for performances, holidays, or weather.

cards.title: East Main Street — Central Library
cards.subtitle: East Main Street corridor; 140 E. Main St.
cards.notes: Use the Central Branch as a focused reading or exhibition stop, and confirm any gallery display dates before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: The city identifies the Central Branch as an East Main Street location with exhibition space.
cards.evidence_claim: Lexington identifies the Lexington Public Library Central Branch at 140 East Main Street and notes its third-floor exhibition space.
cards.source_title: 250Lex, Faulkner Morgan Archive celebrate LGBTQ history
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library and exhibition hours directly with Lexington Public Library before visiting.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Transylvania traditions connecting new students, Halloween season, campus history, and commencement ceremony.

cards.title: Greet Line
cards.subtitle: First-year orientation at Old Morrison
cards.notes: Join the orientation Greet Line in your class shirt and introduce yourself as the line moves through every member of the incoming class.
cards.short_summary: A first-year introduction ritual held at Old Morrison.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania identifies the Greet Line as an annual first-year tradition and schedules it at Old Morrison during orientation.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for incoming students during new-student orientation; consult the current orientation schedule.

cards.title: Learn the Campus Cheer
cards.subtitle: New-student orientation at Old Morrison
cards.notes: Listen for the campus cheer during orientation, then join your incoming class for this shared welcome activity before the class photo.
cards.short_summary: An orientation cheer explicitly named as a Transy tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania’s 2026 orientation schedule calls the campus cheer one of three important Transy traditions.
cards.access_notes: Part of new-student orientation programming; participation details are provided to incoming students.

cards.title: PumpkinMania at Old Morrison
cards.subtitle: Pumpkin display on the Old Morrison steps
cards.notes: Carve a pumpkin through the festival’s community activities, then return after dark to see the illuminated display on Old Morrison’s steps.
cards.short_summary: A campus-hosted fall pumpkin display that became a Lexington tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania’s timeline says PumpkinMania began on Old Morrison’s steps in 2011 and now features more than 500 glowing jack-o’-lanterns.
cards.source_title: Transylvania and Lexington: 250 Years of Shared History
cards.access_notes: Annual fall event; verify the current year’s carving and viewing details with Transylvania before going.

cards.title: Raf Week
cards.subtitle: Late-October celebration of Constantine Samuel Rafinesque
cards.notes: Check the Student Activities Board’s current lineup for the Halloween-season events honoring Transylvania professor Constantine Samuel Rafinesque.
cards.short_summary: A school-specific week of events built around an eccentric former professor.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania describes Raf Week as a longstanding, important Transylvania tradition honoring Rafinesque around his birthday.
cards.source_title: Transylvania Student Activities Board plans weeklong celebration of eccentric professor
cards.access_notes: Events change annually and are organized by the Student Activities Board; follow current campus announcements.

cards.title: The Raf's Tomb Overnight RAF-fle
cards.subtitle: Old Morrison tomb of Constantine Samuel Rafinesque
cards.notes: Attend eligible Raf Week events and follow the current RAF-fle rules for the chance to join the supervised overnight tradition in Raf’s tomb.
cards.short_summary: A raffle-based overnight tied to the campus’s Rafinesque lore.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania reports that students have been passing the night inside Raf’s tomb for decades, with entries earned through Raf Week activities.
cards.source_title: Transylvania Student Activities Board plans weeklong celebration of eccentric professor
cards.access_notes: Access is limited to selected raffle winners and governed by the current Student Activities Board event rules.

cards.title: Haunted Hallway
cards.subtitle: Poole Residence Hall during Raf Week
cards.notes: Watch for the annual Raf Week announcement, then attend or volunteer through the official event process for the themed Haunted Hallway.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, student-run Halloween hallway event.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania calls the Raf Week Haunted Hallway one of the Student Activities Board’s signature events and locates it in Poole Residence Hall.
cards.source_title: Transylvania University SAB conjures up campus chills for Raf Week
cards.access_notes: Held as part of Raf Week; dates, entry details, and volunteer opportunities vary by year.

cards.title: The Kissing Tree
cards.subtitle: White ash outside the library
cards.notes: Find the white ash outside the library, sit on its surrounding bench, and read the university’s account of the alumni stories behind its name.
cards.short_summary: A named campus tree associated with generations of alumni lore.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania identifies the nearly 300-year-old white ash outside the library as the Kissing Tree, a beloved campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark on campus; treat the historic tree and surrounding seating with care.

cards.title: Campus Sing
cards.subtitle: Greek-letter organization performance tradition
cards.notes: Look for the annual Campus Sing program to watch participating student organizations present choreographed dance and lip-sync performances.
cards.short_summary: A long-running performance event involving Transylvania Greek-letter groups.
cards.evidence_claim: A Transylvania magazine documents Chi Omega’s annual Campus Sing as a Transy tradition of more than 40 years, featuring fraternity and sorority performances.
cards.access_notes: Check current student-organization and campus-event announcements for whether and when the event is offered.

cards.title: Crimson Tassels at Commencement
cards.subtitle: Bachelor’s-degree candidates at Transylvania commencement
cards.notes: At commencement, notice the crimson tassels worn by bachelor’s-degree candidates—a Transylvania-specific departure from the usual black tassels.
cards.short_summary: A distinct color detail in the university’s commencement regalia.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania’s 2026 commencement program states that bachelor’s-degree candidates wear crimson tassels instead of the usual black.
cards.access_notes: Observed during the university’s commencement ceremony; regalia is supplied or directed through graduation processes.

cards.title: The Commencement Mace Procession
cards.subtitle: Faculty procession at Transylvania commencement
cards.notes: Watch the opening procession at commencement for the faculty officer carrying the campus-wood mace that marks the ceremony as officially sanctioned.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial object that opens Transylvania’s formal graduation pageantry.
cards.evidence_claim: Transylvania states that its mace is carried in the commencement procession and signifies that the ceremony has been sanctioned by university leadership.
cards.access_notes: Visible during the official commencement procession; observe ceremony guidance and seating instructions.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Transylvania University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-centered, under-21-safe sequence for learning Transy’s main gathering, study, arts, recreation and dining spaces.

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Campus Center Information Desk
cards.title: Start with the Information Desk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • William T. Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map, ask about current events, and note the lost-and-found location before setting out on your first campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for campus orientation and event assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Desk provides campus information, event assistance, campus maps, lost and found, and game-room assistance.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Campus Center facility hours are daily, 8 a.m.–10:30 p.m.; the Information Desk is daily, 8 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Make a First Meet-Up at Back Circle
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus courtyard
cards.notes: Use this residence-hall courtyard as a simple meet-up point, then walk together to the next stop rather than splitting up on day one.
cards.short_summary: A named campus green space surrounded by residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Back Circle is a student green space and courtyard surrounded by residence halls.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor-space access details are not stated on the source; follow campus guidance and any posted event restrictions.

cards.entity_name: J. Douglas Gay Jr./Frances Carrick Thomas Library
cards.title: Locate Your Library Help
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • 300 N Broadway
cards.notes: Find the research desk and save the library contact details; return when you need a librarian, archives help, or a focused study setting.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with research support, special collections and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers reference-librarian research guidance, special collections, the Farris Rare Book Room, and Transylvania University archives.
cards.access_notes: The source lists the library address and contact information but does not state visitor or weekend hours; confirm before a dedicated visit.

cards.title: Pause Among the Alumni Bricks
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • heart of campus
cards.notes: Sit at one of the tables, look closely at the engraved bricks, and use the plaza as a waypoint between Old Morrison and the arts buildings.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus plaza with tables, chairs and alumni-brick details.
cards.evidence_claim: Alumni Plaza is an outdoor campus space with tables and chairs where students study, eat and meet.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies it as an outdoor campus space; access specifics are not stated.

cards.title: See the Campus Landmark
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • 251 W. Third St.
cards.notes: Walk to the lawn and exterior, then use the university’s self-guided-tour material to connect the building with Transy’s early history.
cards.short_summary: A National Historic Landmark and central Transy building.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Morrison was built in 1834, is a National Historic Landmark, and houses university administrative offices.
cards.access_notes: The source describes the building and its administrative offices; interior visitor access is not specified.

cards.title: Check What Is On at Mitchell
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • campus arts venue
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled performance or exhibition, and check the official event or ticket information before planning an indoor visit.
cards.short_summary: A Transy arts venue with theaters, a recital hall and Morlan Gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Mitchell Fine Arts Center includes Carrick Theater, Haggin Auditorium, Coleman Recital Hall and Morlan Gallery; it hosts performance, school, community and academic events.
cards.access_notes: Events and ticketing vary; consult the venue’s current listing before attending.

cards.title: Walk Past the Athletics Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Fourth Street
cards.notes: Use the marked campus-map destination for a daylight walk-by and learn which Pioneer teams use the track-and-field complex.
cards.short_summary: A Transy athletics complex for field hockey, lacrosse, soccer and track and field.
cards.evidence_claim: The Transylvania Athletic Complex has an 860-seat grandstand, eight-lane track and artificial-turf field for field hockey, lacrosse, soccer and track and field.
cards.access_notes: The complex is listed as a campus facility; event attendance and building access depend on the schedule.

cards.title: Plan Dinner at the Raf
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Check the current dinner window, then meet your group at the Raf rather than relying on a meal schedule from an older orientation handout.
cards.short_summary: A named Transy dining location with breakfast service listed on the Campus Center page.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center’s information page lists breakfast service in the Raf on weekdays from 7–9 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The cited page identifies breakfast hours for the Raf but does not list Saturday dinner hours; confirm current dining service before going.

cards.entity_name: William T. Young Campus Center Game Room
cards.title: Try the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Young Campus Center
cards.notes: Bring a valid photo ID if you want to rent a game, and use the listed academic-year hours to keep this stop inside the building schedule.
cards.short_summary: An indoor Campus Center activity space with stated academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room is in the William T. Young Campus Center and requires a valid photo ID to rent any game.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Game Room hours are daily, 12 p.m.–10 p.m.; a valid photo ID is required to rent a game.

cards.title: Finish with Late-Night Dining
cards.subtitle: Saturday night • Young Campus Center
cards.notes: If you need an evening food stop, verify the posted menu and use the university’s listed late-night window before the Campus Center closes.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Center dining room with a published late-night dining period.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center information page lists late-night dining from 7–9 p.m. and identifies the Great Hall Dining Room at the North Broadway entrance.
cards.access_notes: Late Night Dining is listed daily, 7–9 p.m.; academic-year Campus Center facility hours are daily, 8 a.m.–10:30 p.m.
